name: National Cultural Framework
claim: Develop an integrated system of place-based cultural development.
actions: Proposes coordination/alignment across national, regional and local actors.
target: No single numeric integration target identified in the C38 source set.
budget: No single new pooled cultural budget identified by the framework itself.

name: Greater Manchester
claim: Support cultural organisations through a revised 2026–29 investment approach aligned to the Greater Manchester Strategy.
actions: Revised Spirit/Sustain; Inspire and Strategic continue; new sustainability pillar; sector-led body approved in principle.
target: Indicative three-year investment period, but annual Culture Fund budget approval remains required. No universal outcome target inferred.
budget: 2023–26 predecessor budget: £4.425m/year. C38 does not assume the 2026–29 amount is identical.

name: Liverpool City Region
claim: Use the Integrated Settlement to increase local control and longer-term planning across six policy areas.
actions: More than 20 previous streams consolidated; Creative Places Growth Fund is one identifiable culture/creative stream.
target: No culture-wide numeric outcome target identified in the settlement announcement.
budget: Creative Places Growth Fund amounts are identified separately; the £1.5bn settlement is not a culture budget.

name: West Yorkshire
claim: Connect culture, heritage, sport and creative industries to wider regional priorities.
actions: Framework work plus investment programmes including You Can Make It Here 2.
target: Programme outputs were increased with funding/timeframe change; exact output table must be cited before display.
budget: You Can Make It Here 2: £9.003906m total after March 2026 change; Creative Places Growth Fund separate.

name: West Midlands
claim: Use integrated funding for regional economic-development priorities including the creative economy.
actions: WM Collaborator Fund: Networks, Leadership and Freelancer strands.
target: Runs Sep 2026–Mar 2029; no invented outcome number.
budget: £2.95m Integrated Settlement revenue via Creative Places Growth Fund.
